system.summary: Vigenère, standard 26-letter alphabet, key of eight letters restarted at every word; MFTDBSJV (14 Mar - 17 Apr 1914), LETCARIV (10 Mar, provisional), OVHXZIRF (20 May, provisional).

solution.what: Daniel Bourdeau finds the system and rebuilds MFTDBSJV from the pencil decipherment of pagfis 1319; trial readings of six telegrams; LETCARIV for 10 March (research/latam_vetting/1470_sample.txt).

Blind transcription and pre-registration frozen by hash; MFTDBSJV fixed on pagfis 1319 alone, measured on 731 held-out letters: 0.733 with the pre-registered lexicon (criterion 0.85 not met), 0.865 with the declared post-hoc lexicon amendment, vs max 0.129 for 2000 controls.
All telegrams in key MFTDBSJV read: 1043 cipher letters, 97.2%; 10 March (LETCARIV) and 20 May (new key OVHXZIRF, ciphertext-only) read provisionally.

outcome.method_basis: Key MFTDBSJV rebuilt by Daniel Bourdeau from the contemporary pencil decipherment, re-derived and validated on held-out telegrams; 20 May key found ciphertext-only (provisional).
outcome.fraction_read_source: Daniel's rule by cipher letter (reading_count.md): 1440 letters, 1377 sure, 3 probable, 42 restored, 18 unresolved; key MFTDBSJV part 1043 letters, 97.2%.

validation.notes: Contributor's pre-registered held-out test (not docs/_validate.py), key MFTDBSJV only: fixed on pagfis 1319, measured on 731 held-out letters. Pre-registered lexicon 0.733 (fails 0.85); declared post-hoc amendment A1 (larger lexicon by rule) 0.865 vs max of 2000 controls 0.129. LETCARIV and OVHXZIRF do not pass (provisional).

texts.label: Cipher telegrams Rio de Janeiro -> Fortaleza, 10 March - 20 May 1914 (FSC pce 1914.03.10/4)
texts.summary: Telegrams to Col./Gen. Setembrino de Carvalho, federal commander at Fortaleza during the Juazeiro sedition, from the Minister of War Vespasiano de Albuquerque, his aide-de-camp and son-in-law Rego Barros, and E. Pamplona: reports that Governor Franco Rabelo's palace was mined and the engineer's account of the works under it, Ceará faction politics (Thomaz Cavalcanti, Liberato), telegraph staff, the Pernambuco judge and the Supreme Court, and a reserved warning on 20 May that the Minister was displeased by a cipher telegraph conversation.

reading_review.note: Read as sentences 12 Nov 2026 against translation.md: coherent telegraphic Portuguese of 1914 throughout the MFTDBSJV telegrams (palace mining report, no. 52414 in full, Pinheiro, Andrade Fortuna, Gonçalo Souto, Pernambuco judge). Unresolved: MRELDTKRIMV (1326), SUQHSJU (1328). Grade B because 10 March and 20 May rest on keys not validated and need many slip corrections.
